question_or_proposition: For Flow at Outfall 001, do the discharge-limitation entries 'Report MGD' and '***' establish that no enforceable numeric effluent limit applies (only reporting), and does footnote (*1) 'When discharging' make the 2/Week monitoring requirement applicable only during periods when discharge from Outfall 001 is occurring?
required_context: Section 1 header: FINAL Effluent Limits – Outfall 001 – Intermittent Flow
DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS table column structure (lbs/day and mg/l limit columns)
source_locator: aztec/final_permit.pdf, Page 3, Section part_i, Flow row in DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS table
notes: The nominated Flow row combines report-only limit designations with a discharge-conditioned monitoring frequency for an intermittent-flow outfall; resolving how to read these entries affects limit classification (Purpose A), monitoring applicability (Purpose B), and how to treat periods without reported Flow estimates (Purpose C).
